positioning.headline: Data Scientist | AI Engineer | Applied Machine Learning
positioning.short_tagline: Evaluated machine-learning systems on tested data, published with their validation design and stated limitations.
focus_areas: Fraud risk, financial forecasting, predictive maintenance, and computer-vision quality review
Validation design: time-based holdout, walk-forward with embargo, GroupKFold, calibration, threshold simulation
Analytics engineering underneath the models: dbt, BigQuery, DuckDB, Power BI
LLM applications on Gemini and Genkit, with measured retrieval and faithfulness

default_reading_path.label: Data Scientist
default_reading_path.why: These five projects show validated modeling across tabular, time-ordered, and image problems, including results that fell short and are reported as such.

lead_projects.thesis: End-to-end fraud risk intelligence: DuckDB, BigQuery, dbt, LightGBM, FastAPI, and a live executive dashboard.
metrics: 38 dbt models, 126 data tests, 23 Python contract tests
what_it_proves: Ranking and review-queue framing for imbalanced fraud data

lead_projects.thesis: Short-horizon return forecasting over 804.5M rows, where the main result is an investigation into why the leaderboard disagreed with the hold-out. Research only, not investment advice.
metrics: Graded score 0.128, below the field median
what_it_proves: Reporting results that contradict the hope

lead_projects.thesis: Steel defect classification on NEU-CLS with an entropy-based review queue and an embedding-RAG assistant.
metrics: Top-20% entropy queue captures 81.8% of errors
RAG: 94.8% hit@4 (TF-IDF 89.6%), 75.7% of answer sentences entailed (no retrieval 20.7%)

lead_projects.thesis: Predictive-maintenance analytics on UCI AI4I plus a NASA C-MAPSS RUL case study, with SHAP, drift detection, and a ranked maintenance queue.
metrics: Top-10% queue captures 94.1% of failures at 9.4x lift
what_it_proves: Classification and RUL regression on maintenance data

lead_projects.thesis: Retinopathy grading that tests its own claims: shortcut baseline, pre-registered external validation, and a fine-tuning experiment isolating the failure to training labels. Not a medical device.
metrics: IDRiD referable AUC 0.984; Messidor-2 0.819 (below the pre-registered target)
what_it_proves: Stating limitations with the same weight as successes

lead_projects.thesis: dbt Cloud, BigQuery, and Power BI pipeline turning raw e-commerce events and orders into BI-ready marts.
metrics: 4 BI-ready marts, 73 dbt tests, 57 DuckDB CI tests
what_it_proves: Governed analytics engineering and BI delivery

supporting_evidence.proof_area: Industrial AI assistant with document-grounded answers
Industrial UX and HMI state modeling
